text: Whoa... is the desktop supposed to spin?
I'm a paperclip, not a ferris wheel!
Everything is wiggly. Why is everything wiggly?
Please put me down. Gently. Very gently.
I see stars. Cute ones, but still.
Note to self: paperclips do not enjoy roller coasters.
Ooh, my wire is all in a twist!
One more spin and I'll need a lie-down.
Was that an earthquake, or just you?
I think my eyes are stuck in a spiral. Are they?
